column1: # note: The 2025 New Jersey Tax Rate Schedules, which the booklet says to use when taxable income (line 42) is $100,000 or more; the tax table covers less than $100,000.

# note: Table A covers single and married/CU partner filing separately; Table B covers married/CU couple filing jointly, head of household and qualifying widow(er)/surviving CU partner. Each is repeated for every status it covers.

# note: Each row figures tax as line 42 times the rate, less the amount to subtract. Each row holds base_tax = -(that amount) and of_excess_over = 0, so base_tax + rate x (income - of_excess_over) is that same figure.

# note: Table B's $70,000-$80,000 row prints $1,154.50 to subtract. The tax table's rows in that range match $1,155.00, as does N.J.S.A. 54A:2-1(b) ($1,295 plus 3.5% of the excess over $70,000). The row is transcribed as printed; the test probes the schedules only from $100,000, so the row is not probed.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
